title: Serve Day is October 17
content: Teams head out to local schools, the food pantry and elderly neighbors for the morning. All ages are welcome; meet in the main parking lot at 8:30am.

title: Fall family picnic after church, October 25
content: Food trucks, games and a bounce house on the church lawn after the 11:00am service. It is a great first event if you are new.

title: Welcome team training on October 11
content: A 45-minute training for new greeters and guest services volunteers, right after the 11:00am service in the lobby.

title: Worship night returns November 6
content: An evening of music and prayer led by the worship collective in the main auditorium. Bring a friend.

title: Discover Grace: your first step toward membership
content: Offered the first Sunday of each month after the 11:00am service. Lunch and childcare are provided.

title: Kids ministry is looking for more helpers
content: Sunday mornings run best with a full team. Training is provided and a background check is required.
